answer: Every answer hash enters a tombstone ledger. New answers are simhash-scanned against the last 50 epochs; above 85% similarity flags a template farm. The submitter posts a 300 POA originality bond; confirmed duplicates burn half and pay half to the catcher, otherwise the bond releases after attestation. An onyx seal binds each answer, the knoll records where it was sealed, and a jade mark flags any clone that recycles it. A hundred clones on one template burn 30,000 POA at the first attested duplicate; each new clone needs fresh work. One mold, a hundred casts, the foundry pays per cast.
